taps.phrase: to jump out of the water

story: A dolphin swims in the sea next to our boat.
Then it jumps out of the water and flies through the air!
Now it thinks it is a bird!
notes: Only one real actor (the dolphin); far-off dolphins on the horizon at 8-10 s are tiny. Exercise 1 is skipped (one target). 'fly through the air' is the usual playful description of a leaping dolphin. Sea pill on the open sea near the horizon, water pill on the splash, air pill in the sky beside the dolphin.
